Post 1

📉 ASX 200 slipped below its 125-day moving average Wednesday, closing at 8,834.50, down 52.30pts or 0.59%. Now 4.97% off its 52-week high. The trend is quietly turning. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 Materials led losses at -1.46%, Industrials -1.25%, A-REITs -1.10%. Utilities bucked the trend at +1.17%, Energy +0.86%. Defensives holding while cyclicals bleed — classic late-cycle rotation. #ASX #materials #energy

Post 3

🟢 Block Inc surged +6.06% to AUD116.31, the session's standout. NXT added +4.15% to AUD6.53. Tech was the one pocket of conviction in an otherwise defensive tape. #ASX #ausbiz #tech

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD5,754.46/oz, Silver AUD73.72/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.6983, metals priced in local terms remain elevated — providing a partial cushion for producers even as the broader market retreats. #gold #silver #ASX #mining

Post 5

Defence names cratered today — EOS -7.77%, DRO -7.63%, SLX -9.58%. With the index now under its 125-day MA, does 8,800 hold? Where do you see support? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
